data.name: Murrah
data.gender_notes: Murrah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A leader, guide or director, derived from the Arabic word 'murrah' meaning to guide or direct. The name Murrah carries the meaning “Leader, guide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murrah usually hope their child will grow to embody leader, guide and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The one who guides others on the path of righteousness.
data.etymology: Murrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Leader, guide.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murrah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مرّة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي يعني الشخصية القوية
in_arabic.long_meaning: مرّة هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'مرر' الذي يعني 'المرور' أو 'الانتقال'. يوحي الاسم بالقوة و الصلابة، و قد ورد في بعض المراجع أنه يعني الشخص الذي يمر على الأمور دون تأثر. و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عميقة في التراث الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: مرہ
in_urdu.meaning: مرد کے لئے ایک عربی نام جس کا مطلب مضبوط شخصیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو مذکر ہے اور مضبوط شخصیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے فعل 'مرر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'مرور' یا 'گزرنا'۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں گہری معانی رکھتا ہے اور جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلم معاشرے میں اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुर्रह
in_hindi.meaning: एक अरबी नाम जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत व्यक्तित्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुर्रह एक अरबी नाम है जो مذکر है और मजबूत व्यक्तित्व को दर्शाता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'मरर' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है 'मारना' या 'बीतना'। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्व रखता है और गहरी आध्यात्मिक अर्थ रखता है।

in_pashto.name: مره
in_pashto.meaning: د قوي شخصیت لپاره یو عربي نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: مره یو عربي نوم دی چې مذکر دی او د قوي شخصیت ښودنه کوي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د فعل 'مرر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې 'تیریدل' یا 'کړل' دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو او اسلامی ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Murrah
in_english.meaning: A strong personality name in Islamic tradition
in_english.long_meaning: Murrah is a masculine name derived from the Arabic root 'مرر' (marar), meaning 'to pass' or 'to go through'. It signifies strength and resilience. In Islamic tradition, the name Murrah holds historical significance and connotes a person who navigates through life's challenges with fortitude. The name is associated with positive personality traits such as determination and courage.

pronunciation.urdu: مرہ کا تلفظ م ر ہ
pronunciation.hindi: मुर्रह का उच्चारण मु र्र ह
pronunciation.pashto: مره د تلفظ م ر ه

data.cultural_impact: The name Murrah is considered to be a name of prestige and leadership in Islamic culture. It is a name given to those who are seen as leaders, guides, or directors in their communities. This name reflects the importance of leadership and guidance in Islamic societies and emphasizes the role of individuals in shaping their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Murrah carries the deeper meaning of being a spiritual guide or director. This name embodies the idea of being a servant of Allah who leads others towards the right path and away from the wrong one. The name Murrah is a reminder of the responsibility that each individual has in guiding and directing their own spiritual journey, as well as the journeys of others. It is a name that inspires individuals to be leaders in the truest sense of the word, leading themselves and others towards Allah and His guidance.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Murrah was a famous warrior in the army of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Murrah carried significant weight in that era.
